data: For fiscal 2025, which ended June 30, 2025, Microsoft reported total revenue of about $281.7 billion ($281,724 million), up roughly 15% from $245.1 billion in fiscal 2024. Gross profit was about $193.9 billion ($193,893 million), a gross margin of roughly 68.8%, slightly below the approximately 69.8% of fiscal 2024 as higher AI infrastructure costs weighed on cloud margins. Operating income was about $128.5 billion ($128,528 million), up about 17% from $109.4 billion the year before, an operating margin of roughly 45.6%, compared with about 44.6% in fiscal 2024. These figures come from Microsoft's fiscal 2025 annual report as I recall it, so you may want to confirm the exact numbers against the 10-K.
